english.title: Producer or authorised representative fail to mark EEE with date mark

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer,]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer,]_

failed to mark EEE that you put on the market in such a manner that the equipment could be easily identified as having been placed on the market after 13th August 2005
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(1), 90(2) and 91(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
